What factor of a wetland affects migratory birds? and if the factor changes in the future, how will behaviour change?

Time conventions: GPS times in HMM_Ready_Crane_combined.csv are UTC (03 converts the br tags' KST clock;
27233947 is UTC from Movebank). Climate, water-chemistry and SPI6 times are local (KST) and converted to UTC below.

```{r load package, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(readr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
crane_data <- read.csv("/Users/yjkang/Desktop/NIE_BigData/Grus_Vipio/HMM_Ready_Crane_combined_UTC.csv")
```

```{r}
options(download.file.method = "libcurl")
library(sf)
library(geodata)

kor_muni <- st_as_sf(gadm(country = "KOR", level = 2, path = tempdir()))
prk_prov <- st_as_sf(gadm(country = "PRK", level = 1, path = tempdir()))
kor_country <- st_as_sf(gadm(country = "KOR", level = 0, path = tempdir()))
prk_country <- st_as_sf(gadm(country = "PRK", level = 0, path = tempdir()))

# South Korea
kor_target <- kor_muni %>%
  filter(grepl("Paju|Goyang|Gimpo|Yeoncheon|Cheorwon|Pocheon", NAME_2, ignore.case = T) )%>% #|
         #grepl("Incheon", NAME_1, ignore.case = T)) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 32649)

# North Korea
prk_target <- prk_prov %>%
  filter(grepl("Kaesong|Gaesung|Gesung|Kesung|Gaeseong|Kaeseong", NAME_1, ignore.case = T)) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 32649)

# DMZ
kor_utm_border <- st_transform(kor_country, crs = 32649)
prk_utm_border <- st_transform(prk_country, crs = 32649)
# Find the touching border (MDL) and buffer it by 2km to create the DMZ
prk_lines <- st_cast(prk_utm_border, "MULTILINESTRING")
mdl_line <- st_intersection(prk_lines, st_buffer(kor_utm_border, 100))
dmz_polygon <- st_buffer(mdl_line, dist = 2000)

master_boundary <- st_union(kor_target) %>%
  st_union(prk_target) %>%
  st_union(dmz_polygon)
```

```{r}
crane_sf <- st_as_sf(crane_data, coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 32649, remove = FALSE)
```

# Hangang subset region assignment
```{r}
crane_deg <- st_transform(crane_target_region, crs = 4326)
lon_coords <- st_coordinates(crane_deg)[, 1]

crane_Hangang_df <- as.data.frame(crane_target_region) %>%
  select(-geometry) %>%  #Drop the geometry so it's ready for the temporal merge
  mutate(
    time = as.POSIXct(time, format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tz = "UTC"),
    #Round the 30-min GPS time to the nearest Hour for merging
    Join_Time = lubridate::round_date(time, "30 min"),
    # Assign the station
    Station = ifelse(lon_coords <= 126.875, "Paju", "Cheorwon")
  )%>%
  arrange(ID, time)

cat("\nTotal Crane GPS points:", nrow(crane_data))
cat("\nPoints physically in the Hangang region:", nrow(crane_Hangang_df), "\n")
```

# Match corresponding climate to GPS data

```{r}
library(lubridate)

paju_clim <- read.csv("/Users/yjkang/Desktop/NIE_BigData/wetland_birds/data/한강습지/env_variable/hourly_climate/paju_climate_2014_2024.csv")
cheorwon_clim <- read.csv("/Users/yjkang/Desktop/NIE_BigData/wetland_birds/data/한강습지/env_variable/hourly_climate/cheorwon_climate_2014_2024.csv")
climate_all <- bind_rows(paju_clim, cheorwon_clim)

# THE TIMEZONE FIX:
climate_all <- climate_all %>%
  mutate(
    # Step A: Parse the text as KST (Asia/Seoul)
    Date_Time = as.POSIXct(Date_Time, format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tz="Asia/Seoul"),
    Date_Time = with_tz(Date_Time, format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tzone = "UTC")
  )

#interpolate 30 minutes
climate_all <- climate_all %>%
  group_by(Station) %>%
  # 'complete' generates the 30-min sequence for each group's time range
  complete(Date_Time = seq(min(Date_Time), max(Date_Time), by = "30 min")) %>%
  # linear interpolation
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~zoo::na.approx(., na.rm = FALSE))) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# INTERPOLATE temporal resolution
```{r}
library(zoo) # For the na.approx() interpolation function

water_chem <- read.csv("/Users/yjkang/Desktop/NIE_BigData/wetland_birds/data/한강습지/env_variable/water_Chem_paju_cheorwon_2016_2024.csv")
drought <- read.csv("/Users/yjkang/Desktop/NIE_BigData/wetland_birds/data/한강습지/env_variable/daily_drought/cheorwon_paju_spi6_2016_2024.csv")

water_prep <- water_chem %>%
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%Y.%m.%d"),
    Env_Time = as.POSIXct(paste(Date, "12:00:00"), tz = "Asia/Seoul"),
    Env_Time = with_tz(Env_Time, tzone = "UTC")
  ) %>%
  select(Station, Env_Time, BOD, Chlorophyll, DTN, Water_Temperature)
drought_prep <- drought %>%
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(Date_Time),
    Env_Time = as.POSIXct(paste(Date, "12:00:00"), tz = "Asia/Seoul"),
    Env_Time = with_tz(Env_Time, tzone = "UTC")
  ) %>%
  select(Station, Env_Time, SPI6)

# Find the absolute start and end of your crane data
# (Padding by a few days to ensure the calendar covers everything)
min_time <- floor_date(min(crane_covariates$time, na.rm = TRUE), "day") - days(2)
max_time <- ceiling_date(max(crane_covariates$time, na.rm = TRUE), "day") + days(2)

# Create an empty grid of every single hour for both stations
hourly_calendar <- expand.grid(
  Env_Time = seq(min_time, max_time, by = "30 min"),
  Station = c("Paju", "Cheorwon"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
master_env_smooth <- hourly_calendar %>%
  # Attach our Noon anchor points
  left_join(water_prep, by = c("Station", "Env_Time")) %>%
  left_join(drought_prep, by = c("Station", "Env_Time")) %>%
  # Group by station so Paju and Cheorwon don't accidentally mix!
  arrange(Station, Env_Time) %>%
  group_by(Station) %>%
  mutate(
    Water_Temp_Smooth  = na.spline(Water_Temperature, na.rm = FALSE), #na.approx=linear approx, na.spline=polynomial
    BOD_Smooth         = na.spline(BOD, na.rm = FALSE), #, rule = 1
    Chlorophyll_Smooth = na.spline(Chlorophyll, na.rm = FALSE),
    DTN_Smooth         = na.spline(DTN, na.rm = FALSE),
    SPI6_Smooth        = na.spline(SPI6, na.rm = FALSE),
    #rule = 1, If the hourly time is before the first record or after the last record, force it to NA.
    Water_Temp_Smooth  = ifelse(Env_Time < min(Env_Time[!is.na(Water_Temperature)]) |
                                Env_Time > max(Env_Time[!is.na(Water_Temperature)]),
                                NA, Water_Temp_Smooth),
    BOD_Smooth         = ifelse(Env_Time < min(Env_Time[!is.na(BOD)]) |
                                Env_Time > max(Env_Time[!is.na(BOD)]),
                                NA, BOD_Smooth),
    Chlorophyll_Smooth = ifelse(Env_Time < min(Env_Time[!is.na(Chlorophyll)]) |
                                Env_Time > max(Env_Time[!is.na(Chlorophyll)]),
                                NA, Chlorophyll_Smooth),
    DTN_Smooth         = ifelse(Env_Time < min(Env_Time[!is.na(DTN)]) |
                                Env_Time > max(Env_Time[!is.na(DTN)]),
                                NA, DTN_Smooth),
    SPI6_Smooth        = ifelse(Env_Time < min(Env_Time[!is.na(SPI6)]) |
                                Env_Time > max(Env_Time[!is.na(SPI6)]),
                                NA, SPI6_Smooth)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() #%>%
  # Keep only the smoothed columns
  #select(Station, Env_Time, Water_Temp_Smooth, BOD_Smooth, Chlorophyll_Smooth, DTN_Smooth, SPI6_Smooth)

# MERGE WITH Hangang CRANE DATA
crane_covariates <- crane_covariates %>%
  mutate(
    # Recreate the hourly join key for your 30-min GPS points
    Join_Time = round_date(time, "30 min")
  ) %>%
  left_join(master_env_smooth, by = c("Station" = "Station", "Join_Time" = "Env_Time")) %>%
  select(-Join_Time) # Clean up the temporary key

head(crane_covariates %>% select(time, Station, SPI6_Smooth, Water_Temp_Smooth))
#write_csv(crane_covariates, "/Users/yjkang/Desktop/Crane_covariates_UTC.csv")
```

# STANDARDIZE THE COVARIATES
```{r}
# Reference mean and SD of every covariate, taken from the historical data the HMM is fitted to.
# Any new covariates fed to this model (the SSP future series in 06, sensitivity runs) must be
# standardised with THESE values, not with their own mean/SD. Re-scaling a future series on
# itself would re-centre it to 0 and erase the projected shift (e.g. warming) before the HMM sees it.
# These are the same centres/scales scale() used before, so the Z-scores and the fitted model are unchanged.
cov_vars <- c("Temp", "Wind", "wTemp", "BOD", "Chlor", "DTN", "SPI6")
scaling_ref <- crane_covs %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(cov_vars),
                   list(mu = ~ mean(., na.rm = TRUE), sd = ~ sd(., na.rm = TRUE))))
print(scaling_ref)
saveRDS(scaling_ref, "/Users/yjkang/Desktop/NIE_BigData/HMM_scaling_ref.rds")  # read by 06

# Standardise a raw covariate with the stored historical reference
z_ref <- function(x, var) (x - scaling_ref[[paste0(var, "_mu")]]) / scaling_ref[[paste0(var, "_sd")]]

crane_covs <- crane_covs %>%
  mutate(
    Z_Temp     = z_ref(Temp,  "Temp"),
    Z_Wind     = z_ref(Wind,  "Wind"),
    Z_wTemp    = z_ref(wTemp, "wTemp"),
    Z_BOD      = z_ref(BOD,   "BOD"),
    Z_Chlor    = z_ref(Chlor, "Chlor"),
    Z_DTN      = z_ref(DTN,   "DTN"),
    Z_SPI6     = z_ref(SPI6,  "SPI6")
  )

library(momentuHMM)
hmm_data <- crane_covs %>% ungroup() %>%
  select(-step, -angle) %>% #drop old step and angle so prepData can calculate them afresh
  filter(time >= as.POSIXct("2018-02-04", tz = "UTC")) %>%  #Filter out before the Cheorwon sensor came online. 2018-03-05
  as.data.frame() %>%
  prepData(type = "UTM", coordNames = c("x", "y"))
class(hmm_data) #Should say "momentuHMMData" "data.frame"
```

# Mean Imputation
```{r}
#HMM cannot have NA for predictors (step,angle are okay), so Z-score mean 0 is imputed onto NA.
#cannot simply erase the rows as it crashes the chronological step order of the chain.
total_rows <- nrow(hmm_data)
missing_stats <- data.frame(
  Variable = c("Z_Temp", "Z_Wind", "Z_BOD", "Z_SPI6", "Z_wTemp", "Z_Chlor", "Z_DTN"),
  Missing_Count = c(
    sum(is.na(hmm_data$Z_Temp)), sum(is.na(hmm_data$Z_Wind)), #sum(is.na(hmm_data$Z_hPa)),
    sum(is.na(hmm_data$Z_BOD)), sum(is.na(hmm_data$Z_SPI6)), sum(is.na(hmm_data$Z_wTemp)),
    sum(is.na(hmm_data$Z_Chlor)), sum(is.na(hmm_data$Z_DTN))
  )
)
missing_stats <- missing_stats %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = round((Missing_Count / total_rows) * 100, 2)
  )
print(missing_stats)

# Mean Imputation, replace predictor NA with z-score mean 0.
hmm_data <- hmm_data %>%
  mutate(
    Z_Temp  = replace_na(Z_Temp, 0),
    Z_Wind  = replace_na(Z_Wind, 0),
    Z_BOD   = replace_na(Z_BOD, 0),
    Z_wTemp = replace_na(Z_wTemp, 0),
    Z_Chlor = replace_na(Z_Chlor, 0),
    Z_DTN   = replace_na(Z_DTN, 0),
    Z_SPI6  = replace_na(Z_SPI6, 0)
  )
#write_csv(hmm_data, "/Users/yjkang/Desktop/Hangang_covariates.csv")
```

# Merge back to the entire trajectory
```{r}
#climate variables are only attached to the Hangang region
global_crane <- crane_data
hangang_covs <- hmm_data

#match timestamp
global_crane <- global_crane %>%
  mutate(time = as.POSIXct(time, format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tz = "UTC"))
hangang_covs <- hangang_covs %>%
  mutate(time = as.POSIXct(time, format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tz = "UTC")) %>%
  select(ID, time, Station, Temp, Wind, wTemp, BOD, Chlor, DTN, SPI6,
         Z_Temp, Z_Wind, Z_wTemp, Z_BOD, Z_Chlor, Z_DTN, Z_SPI6)

# employ SPATIAL SWITCH to environment predictors for regions that are not Hangang
master_global <- global_crane %>%
  left_join(hangang_covs, by = c("ID", "time")) %>%
  mutate(
    # A. Create the Switch
    In_Hangang = ifelse(!is.na(Station), 1, 0),
    # B. Mean Imputation: Patch the millions of global NAs with 0. Switch will turn this off anyways.
    Z_Temp  = replace_na(Z_Temp, 0),
    Z_Wind  = replace_na(Z_Wind, 0),
    Z_wTemp  = replace_na(Z_wTemp, 0),
    Z_BOD   = replace_na(Z_BOD, 0),
    Z_Chlor  = replace_na(Z_Chlor, 0),
    Z_DTN  = replace_na(Z_DTN, 0),
    Z_SPI6  = replace_na(Z_SPI6, 0),
    # C. Multiply weather by the Switch
    # Outside Korea: Weather * 0 = 0
    # Inside Korea: Weather * 1 = Actual Hangang Z-Score
    Han_Temp  = Z_Temp * In_Hangang,
    Han_Wind  = Z_Wind * In_Hangang,
    Han_wTemp = Z_wTemp  * In_Hangang,
    Han_BOD   = Z_BOD  * In_Hangang,
    Han_Chlor = Z_Chlor  * In_Hangang,
    Han_DTN   = Z_DTN  * In_Hangang,
    Han_SPI6  = Z_SPI6 * In_Hangang
  )
```


```{r}
# Convert the newly calculated steps to kilometers and prevent zero-crashes!
global_hmm_data$step <- global_hmm_data$step / 1000
global_hmm_data$step[global_hmm_data$step == 0] <- 0.0001

# Apply the mathematical artifact cleaner to neutralize "fake" steps
is_interpolated <- c(FALSE, abs(diff(global_hmm_data$step)) < 1e-10)
global_hmm_data$step[is_interpolated] <- NA
global_hmm_data$angle[is_interpolated] <- NA

hist(log(global_hmm_data$step), breaks = 100)
hist(global_hmm_data$angle, breaks = 100)
print(sum(global_hmm_data$step == 0, na.rm = TRUE))
```

# run base HMM
```{r}
global_step_km <- c(45.0, 8.0, 0.02,   # Means: Migration (45km), Foraging (8km), Roosting (20m)
                    10.0, 6.5, 0.01 )  # SDs

global_angle <- c(0, pi, 0,         # Means: Migration 0 (straight), Foraging pi (turning back), Roosting 0
                  8.0, 0.5, 0.1 )   # Concentrations: Migration 8.0 (highly directional), Foraging 0.5 (zigzagging), Roosting 0.1 (random/flat)

# Fit without covariates to get base parameters of crane behaviour
start_time <- Sys.time()
model_base <- fitHMM(
  #nlmPar = list(print.level = 2),  #print out gradients
  data = global_hmm_data,
  nbStates = 3,
  dist = list(step = "gamma", angle = "vm"),
  Par0 = list(step = global_step_km, angle = global_angle),
  estAngleMean = list(angle = TRUE),
  formula = ~ 1  # No covariates
)
end_time <- Sys.time()
print(end_time - start_time)
print(model_base, ask = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#dynamic HMM for wintering subset in hangang region
hangang_data <- global_hmm_data[global_hmm_data$In_Hangang == 1, ]

#fix the parameters computed from the base model
global_step_pars <- c(5.927842, 0.3972410, 0.04351320,   # Means: Traveling, Foraging, Roosting
                      8.558490, 0.3196354, 0.04634466 )  # SDs

global_angle_pars <- c(-0.004563477, 0.008767228, -0.008541543,         # Means
                       0.755783352, 1.390751093,  0.691495849 )   # Concentrations

start_time <- Sys.time()
global_dynamic_model <- fitHMM(
  #nlmPar = list(print.level = 2),
  data = hangang_data,
  nbStates = 3,
  dist = list(step = "gamma", angle = "vm"),
  Par0 = list(step = global_step_pars, angle = global_angle_pars),
  estAngleMean = list(angle = TRUE),
  fixPar = list(step = global_step_pars, angle = global_angle_pars),
  formula = ~ Han_Temp +Han_Wind +Han_SPI6 +Han_wTemp +Han_BOD +Han_DTN +Han_Chlor
)
end_time <- Sys.time()
print(end_time - start_time)
print(global_dynamic_model, ask = FALSE)
```

# MULTIPLE INITIALISATION / CONVERGENCE CHECK
```{r multistart check}
# Step and angle parameters are fixed, so only the transition betas are estimated.
# Refit from random beta starting values
set.seed(2026)
n_starts    <- 10
ref_beta    <- global_dynamic_model$mle$beta
ref_nllk    <- global_dynamic_model$mod$minimum      # negative log-likelihood of the reported fit
dyn_formula <- ~ Han_Temp + Han_Wind + Han_SPI6 + Han_wTemp + Han_BOD + Han_DTN + Han_Chlor

random_beta0 <- function() {
  b <- ref_beta
  b[] <- runif(length(b), -1, 1)                     # covariate effects (logit scale)
  b["(Intercept)", ] <- runif(ncol(b), -5, 0)        # baseline switching rates
  b
}

ms_fits <- lapply(seq_len(n_starts), function(s) {
  t0  <- Sys.time()
  fit <- tryCatch(fitHMM(
      data = hangang_data, nbStates = 3,
      dist = list(step = "gamma", angle = "vm"),
      Par0 = list(step = global_step_pars, angle = global_angle_pars),
      beta0 = random_beta0(),
      estAngleMean = list(angle = TRUE),
      fixPar = list(step = global_step_pars, angle = global_angle_pars),
      formula = dyn_formula),
    error = function(e) { message("Start ", s, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
  cat("Start", s, if (is.null(fit)) "- FAILED\n" else "- done\n")
  list(fit = fit, mins = as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins")))
})

# One row per start: optimiser exit code (nlm: 1 or 2 = converged), smallest Hessian
# eigenvalue (> 0 means a proper minimum), and distance of the betas from the reported model
ms_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(ms_fits), function(s) {
  f <- ms_fits[[s]]$fit
  if (is.null(f)) return(data.frame(Start = s, nllk = NA, code = NA, minEigen = NA,
                                    maxAbsDiffBeta = NA, mins = ms_fits[[s]]$mins))
  min_eig <- tryCatch(min(eigen(f$mod$hessian, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values),
                      error = function(e) NA)
  data.frame(Start = s, nllk = f$mod$minimum, code = f$mod$code, minEigen = min_eig,
             maxAbsDiffBeta = max(abs(f$mle$beta - ref_beta)), mins = ms_fits[[s]]$mins)
}))
best_nllk <- min(c(ms_tab$nllk, ref_nllk), na.rm = TRUE)
ms_tab$dNllk <- ms_tab$nllk - best_nllk
print(ms_tab)

tol <- 1e-3   # log-likelihood units
cat(sprintf("\nConverged (nlm code 1/2): %d of %d starts",
            sum(ms_tab$code %in% c(1, 2)), n_starts))
cat(sprintf("\nReached the best optimum (within %g): %d of %d starts",
            tol, sum(ms_tab$dNllk < tol, na.rm = TRUE), n_starts))
cat(sprintf("\nReported model vs best optimum: dNllk = %.4g %s\n", ref_nllk - best_nllk,
            if (ref_nllk - best_nllk < tol) "(OK: reported model is at the best optimum)"
            else "(WARNING: a better optimum was found - refit from that start)"))
```

```{r}
# 10 further refits shifted by N(0, 0.2^2) noise on the logit scale.
# this checks the convergence is stable, no flat or saddle convergence.
set.seed(2027)
n_perturb <- 10
sd_beta   <- 0.2    # SD of logit-scale noise on transition betas

# Draw all perturbed starts up front so they are reproducible and can be inspected
pt_starts <- lapply(seq_len(n_perturb), function(s) {
  b <- ref_beta
  b[] <- ref_beta + rnorm(length(ref_beta), 0, sd_beta)
  b
})

pt_fits <- lapply(seq_len(n_perturb), function(s) {
  t0  <- Sys.time()
  fit <- tryCatch(fitHMM(
      data = hangang_data, nbStates = 3,
      dist = list(step = "gamma", angle = "vm"),
      Par0 = list(step = global_step_pars, angle = global_angle_pars),
      beta0 = pt_starts[[s]],
      estAngleMean = list(angle = TRUE),
      fixPar = list(step = global_step_pars, angle = global_angle_pars),
      formula = dyn_formula),
    error = function(e) { message("Perturbed start ", s, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
  cat("Perturbed start", s, if (is.null(fit)) "- FAILED\n" else "- done\n")
  list(fit = fit, mins = as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins")))
})

# Same summary columns as ms_tab, plus how far each start was moved from the reported betas
pt_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(pt_fits), function(s) {
  f <- pt_fits[[s]]$fit
  start_shift <- max(abs(pt_starts[[s]] - ref_beta))
  if (is.null(f)) return(data.frame(Start = s, startShiftBeta = start_shift, nllk = NA, code = NA,
                                    minEigen = NA, maxAbsDiffBeta = NA, mins = pt_fits[[s]]$mins))
  min_eig <- tryCatch(min(eigen(f$mod$hessian, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values),
                      error = function(e) NA)
  data.frame(Start = s, startShiftBeta = start_shift, nllk = f$mod$minimum, code = f$mod$code,
             minEigen = min_eig, maxAbsDiffBeta = max(abs(f$mle$beta - ref_beta)),
             mins = pt_fits[[s]]$mins)
}))

# Compare against the best optimum found by ANY run (reported fit, random starts, perturbed starts)
best_nllk_all <- min(c(ref_nllk, ms_tab$nllk, pt_tab$nllk), na.rm = TRUE)
pt_tab$dNllk  <- pt_tab$nllk - best_nllk_all
print(pt_tab)

at_best <- pt_tab$dNllk < tol & !is.na(pt_tab$dNllk)
cat(sprintf("\nConverged (nlm code 1/2): %d of %d perturbed starts",
            sum(pt_tab$code %in% c(1, 2)), n_perturb))
cat(sprintf("\nReturned to the best optimum (within %g): %d of %d perturbed starts",
            tol, sum(at_best), n_perturb))
cat(sprintf("\nLargest beta difference from the reported model among those runs: %.3g",
            if (any(at_best)) max(pt_tab$maxAbsDiffBeta[at_best]) else NA))
cat(sprintf("\nReported model vs best optimum over all refits: dNllk = %.4g %s\n",
            ref_nllk - best_nllk_all,
            if (ref_nllk - best_nllk_all < tol) "(OK: reported model is at the best optimum)"
            else "(WARNING: a better optimum was found - refit from that start)"))
```

```{r, fig.height=3.8, fig.width=4, out.width="110%"}
for (var in predictors) {
  pretty_name <- display_names[var]
  # The 100 steps across the X-axis
  z_seq <- seq(-3, 3, length.out = 100)
  plot_data <- data.frame()

  for (z in z_seq) {
    # Create a 1-row dataframe for this exact moment
    current_covs <- as.data.frame(baseline_list)
    current_covs[[var]] <- z
    # Extract the math for this single row
    ci_out <- CIreal(global_dynamic_model, covs = current_covs)
    # Save all 9 transition combinations for this exact Z-score
    for (from_state in 1:3) {
      for (to_state in 1:3) {
        temp_data <- data.frame(
          Predictor_Value = z,
          From = from_state,
          To = to_state,
          Transition = #paste0(from_state, "->", to_state),
                        paste0(c("Travel", "Forage", "Roost")[from_state], " %->% ", c("Travel", "Forage", "Roost")[to_state]),
          Estimate = ci_out$gamma$est[from_state, to_state],
          Lower_CI = ci_out$gamma$lower[from_state, to_state],
          Upper_CI = ci_out$gamma$upper[from_state, to_state]
        )
        plot_data <- rbind(plot_data, temp_data)
      }
    }
  }
  correct_order <- c("Travel %->% Travel", "Travel %->% Forage", "Travel %->% Roost",
                      "Forage %->% Travel", "Forage %->% Forage", "Forage %->% Roost",
                      "Roost %->% Travel", "Roost %->% Forage", "Roost %->% Roost" )
  plot_data$Transition <- factor(plot_data$Transition, levels = correct_order)

  p_var <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Predictor_Value)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Lower_CI, ymax = Upper_CI), fill = "gray40", alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Estimate), color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    facet_wrap(~ Transition, scales = "fixed", ncol = 3, labeller = label_parsed) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    labs(title = paste("Effect of", pretty_name, "on Transition Probability"),
      subtitle = "holding all other variables at average value in Hangang",
      x = paste(pretty_name, "(Z-Score)"),
      y = "Probability") +
    theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90", color = NA), plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(t=10, r = 30, b = 10, l = 10),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8, hjust=0.5),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10.5, hjust=0.5), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, hjust=0.5) )
  print(p_var)
  #ggsave(paste0("/Users/yjkang/Desktop/HMM_Transition_", var, ".pdf"), plot=p_var, height=3.8, width=4)
}
```

==============================================================================================================================
Demonstrate the results are robust to the original temporal resolution of covariates (no interpolation).
```{r}
# ==========================================
# SENSITIVITY: native-resolution covariates, no spline
# ==========================================
spline_vars <- c("wTemp", "BOD", "Chlor", "DTN")
han_names   <- c(wTemp = "Han_wTemp", BOD = "Han_BOD", Chlor = "Han_Chlor", DTN = "Han_DTN", SPI6 = "Han_SPI6")

# Start from the SAME rows used by the main model
hangang_monthly <- hangang_data

# --- Water quality: monthly record per station ---
water_monthly <- water_chem %>%
  mutate(Date  = as.Date(Date, format = "%Y.%m.%d"),
         Month = format(Date, "%Y-%m")) %>%
  group_by(Station, Month) %>%
  summarise(wTemp = mean(Water_Temperature, na.rm = TRUE),
            BOD   = mean(BOD,               na.rm = TRUE),
            Chlor = mean(Chlorophyll,       na.rm = TRUE),
            DTN   = mean(DTN,               na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

env_monthly <- water_monthly %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(spline_vars), ~ ifelse(is.nan(.), NA, .)))   # all-NA months give NaN

# Months and days are defined in KST, because the sampling dates are local
gps_month <- format(with_tz(hangang_monthly$time, "Asia/Seoul"), "%Y-%m")
idx <- match(paste(hangang_monthly$Station, gps_month),
             paste(env_monthly$Station, env_monthly$Month))

for (v in spline_vars) {
  z <- z_ref(env_monthly[[v]][idx], v)   # same historical reference as the main model
  cat(sprintf("%-6s %5.1f%% of fixes with no monthly record -> imputed 0\n",
              v, 100 * mean(is.na(z))))
  z[is.na(z)] <- 0
  hangang_monthly[[han_names[[v]]]] <- z
}

# --- SPI6: daily value per station ---
drought_daily <- drought %>%
  mutate(Day = format(as.Date(Date_Time), "%Y-%m-%d")) %>%
  select(Station, Day, SPI6)

gps_day <- format(with_tz(hangang_monthly$time, "Asia/Seoul"), "%Y-%m-%d")
idx_d   <- match(paste(hangang_monthly$Station, gps_day),
                 paste(drought_daily$Station, drought_daily$Day))

z <- z_ref(drought_daily$SPI6[idx_d], "SPI6")
cat(sprintf("SPI6   %5.1f%% of fixes with no daily record -> imputed 0\n", 100 * mean(is.na(z))))
z[is.na(z)] <- 0
hangang_monthly$Han_SPI6 <- z
```

```{r}
mon_covs <- as.data.frame(hangang_monthly)[, c("step", "Han_Temp", "Han_Wind", "Han_wTemp",
                                               "Han_BOD", "Han_Chlor", "Han_DTN", "Han_SPI6")]
print(round(cor(mon_covs[, -1]), 2))
print(car::vif(lm(step ~ ., data = mon_covs)))

monthly_model <- fitHMM(
  data = hangang_monthly,
  nbStates = 3,
  dist = list(step = "gamma", angle = "vm"),
  Par0 = list(step = global_step_pars, angle = global_angle_pars),
  beta0 = global_dynamic_model$mle$beta,          # warm start
  estAngleMean = list(angle = TRUE),
  fixPar = list(step = global_step_pars, angle = global_angle_pars),
  formula = ~ Han_Temp + Han_Wind + Han_SPI6 + Han_wTemp + Han_BOD + Han_DTN + Han_Chlor
)
monthly_model$data[] <- lapply(monthly_model$data, function(x) if (is.numeric(x)) as.numeric(x) else x)
environment(monthly_model$conditions$formula) <- globalenv()
```

```{r}
#AIC(global_dynamic_model, monthly_model)   # same rows, same no. of parameters, so comparable

# Comparison is valid only if the response and rows are identical; check explicitly
stopifnot(identical(global_dynamic_model$data$ID,    monthly_model$data$ID),
          identical(global_dynamic_model$data$step,  monthly_model$data$step),
          identical(global_dynamic_model$data$angle, monthly_model$data$angle))

# n for BIC: time steps with at least one observed data stream
n_obs <- with(global_dynamic_model$data, sum(!is.na(step) | !is.na(angle)))

ic_row <- function(model, label) {
  aic <- AIC(model)                  # package's own count of free parameters
  ll  <- -model$mod$minimum          # maximised log-likelihood
  k   <- round((aic + 2 * ll) / 2)   # recover k from AIC = -2*logLik + 2k
  data.frame(Model = label, logLik = ll, k = k, n = n_obs,
             AIC = aic, BIC = -2 * ll + log(n_obs) * k)
}

ic_tab <- rbind(ic_row(global_dynamic_model, "Interpolated"),
                ic_row(monthly_model,        "Original")) %>%
  mutate(dAIC = AIC - min(AIC),
         dBIC = BIC - min(BIC))
print(ic_tab)
```

Compare coefficients
```{r}
beta_long <- function(model, label) {
  ci <- CIbeta(model)$beta
  data.frame(Model      = label,
             Covariate  = rep(rownames(ci$est), times = ncol(ci$est)),
             Transition = rep(colnames(ci$est), each  = nrow(ci$est)),
             Est   = as.vector(ci$est),
             Lower = as.vector(ci$lower),
             Upper = as.vector(ci$upper))
}

beta_cmp <- rbind(beta_long(global_dynamic_model, "Interpolated"),
                  beta_long(monthly_model,        "Original")) %>%
  filter(Covariate != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = c("Interpolated", "Original")))

robust_tab <- beta_cmp %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Covariate, Transition), names_from = Model,
              values_from = c(Est, Lower, Upper)) %>%
  mutate(Same_sign        = sign(Est_Interpolated) == sign(Est_Original),
         Sig_Interpolated = Lower_Interpolated > 0 | Upper_Interpolated < 0,
         Sig_Original     = Lower_Original     > 0 | Upper_Original     < 0,
         CI_overlap       = Lower_Original <= Upper_Interpolated &
                            Lower_Interpolated <= Upper_Original)
print(robust_tab, n = Inf, width = Inf)

p_forest <- ggplot(beta_cmp, aes(x = Est, y = Covariate, colour = Model)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "gray50") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = Lower, xmax = Upper),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Transition, ncol = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Interpolated = "black", Original = "firebrick")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  labs(x = "Beta (logit scale)", y = "", colour = "")
print(p_forest)
#ggsave("/Users/yjkang/Desktop/interpolation_check.pdf", plot = p_forest)
```

Overlay transition-probability curves
```{r}
trans_curve <- function(model, var, label) {
  st <- c("Travel", "Forage", "Roost")
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq(-3, 3, length.out = 100), function(z) {
    covs <- as.data.frame(baseline_list); covs[[var]] <- z
    g <- CIreal(model, covs = covs)$gamma
    data.frame(Model = label, Predictor_Value = z,
               Transition = paste0(rep(st, times = 3), " %->% ", rep(st, each = 3)),
               Estimate = as.vector(g$est), Lower_CI = as.vector(g$lower), Upper_CI = as.vector(g$upper))
  }))
}

for (var in han_names) {
  pd <- rbind(trans_curve(global_dynamic_model, var, "Interpolated"),
              trans_curve(monthly_model,        var, "Original"))
  pd$Transition <- factor(pd$Transition, levels = correct_order)
  p <- ggplot(pd, aes(Predictor_Value, Estimate, colour = Model, fill = Model)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Lower_CI, ymax = Upper_CI), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) +
    facet_wrap(~ Transition, ncol = 3, labeller = label_parsed) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Interpolated = "black", Original = "firebrick")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values   = c(Interpolated = "black", Original = "firebrick")) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    labs(title = paste("Sensitivity:", display_names[var]),
         x = paste(display_names[var], "(Z-Score)"), y = "Probability", colour = "", fill = "")
  print(p)
}
```

Check if model is not driven by particular individual.
```{r}
loio <- lapply(unique_birds, function(b) {
  d <- hangang_data[hangang_data$Base_Bird_ID != b, ]
  class(d) <- c("momentuHMMData", "data.frame")
  fit <- tryCatch(fitHMM(
      data = d, nbStates = 3,
      dist = list(step = "gamma", angle = "vm"),
      Par0 = list(step = global_step_pars, angle = global_angle_pars),
      beta0 = global_dynamic_model$mle$beta,
      estAngleMean = list(angle = TRUE),
      fixPar = list(step = global_step_pars, angle = global_angle_pars),
      formula = ~ Han_Temp + Han_Wind + Han_SPI6 + Han_wTemp + Han_BOD + Han_DTN + Han_Chlor),
    error = function(e) NULL)
  cat("Dropped", b, if (is.null(fit)) "- FAILED\n" else "\n")
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  beta_long(fit, b) %>% rename(Dropped = Model)
})
loio_df <- bind_rows(loio) %>% filter(Covariate != "(Intercept)")

full <- beta_long(global_dynamic_model, "Full") %>%
  filter(Covariate != "(Intercept)") %>%
  transmute(Covariate, Transition, Est_full = Est, Sig_full = Lower > 0 | Upper < 0)
```

```{r}
loio_sum <- loio_df %>%
  left_join(full, by = c("Covariate", "Transition")) %>%
  mutate(Sig = Lower > 0 | Upper < 0,
         Flip = sign(Est) != sign(Est_full)) %>%
  group_by(Covariate, Transition) %>%
  summarise(Est_full   = first(Est_full),
            Sig_full   = first(Sig_full),
            LOIO_min   = min(Est), LOIO_max = max(Est),
            n_flip     = sum(Flip),
            most_infl  = Dropped[which.max(abs(Est - Est_full))],
            .groups = "drop")
print(loio_sum %>% filter(Sig_full), n = Inf, width = Inf)   # focus on reported effects
```
